source: Ramflux-Desktop-Design.pen via Pencil MCP GetVariables(), 2026-11-16. Themes axis: mode = light | dark. All values exact as Pencil reports them. Names are the Pencil variable names (referenced in the design as $name).

mobile.note: RF 393x852, safe 59/34 (CURRENT-HANDOFF). Tab bar frame is 83 tall: 8 top padding + 44 item row, remaining 31 is bottom inset (not equal to the 34 safe-bottom: see README inconsistencies).

usage.rf-bg: page / screen background; tab bar, chat header, composer fill
usage.rf-surface: search field, chip, tile, secondary fills
usage.rf-surface-white: cards, tiles inside bubbles, segmented selected segment, switch-off knob (dark: #1E1E1E)
usage.rf-primary: primary button fill, switch-on track, checkbox-on fill, radio ring/dot
usage.rf-on-primary: label on primary, knob on switch-on, check glyph
usage.rf-control: disabled label, checkbox/radio off outline, chevron, send-disabled glyph
usage.rf-line: 0.5 hairline separators (tab bar top, header bottom, row bottom)
usage.rf-line-strong: grabber, unread-divider lines, switch-off track, qr/origin stroke, checkbox draft outline
usage.rf-outgoing*/rf-incoming*: bubble fills and their text/meta/quote colors
usage.rf-scrim: sheet overlay frame on MOB boards (full 393x852 rectangle)
usage.rf-success*/rf-warning*/rf-danger*: status hero, tip/security banners, error text, destructive button

colorLegacyUnthemed.note: pilot-* are older single-value variables (light values only); no component in the mobile kit uses them. Candidates for deletion.

typography.familyUsage: Everything defaults to rf-font (Noto Sans SC, which also covers Latin). rf-font-latin is used only for time stamps, tab label 'Agents', agent tag, origin URL, file type, chart numbers. rf-font-mono for pairing code and mono block (mono block actually uses rf-font-latin).

sizesPx.note: rf-size-caption == rf-size-mobile-caption (11) and rf-size-subheading == rf-size-mobile-body (17), rf-size-page 24, rf-size-metric 32 == rf-size-mobile-large-title 32: duplicate values under different names.

lineHeightsUsed.note: Multipliers of font size as stored by Pencil; unset means the font's built-in line height. No line-height variables exist.

hardcodedSizes.note: Sizes used as literals, not variables, in mobile masters:

values.28/12/8/17/15: avatar initial overrides on boards (see avatar.json)

observedStyles.role: nav-title / sheet title / button label / body (mobile)
observedStyles.weight: 600 (title, button) / normal (body, row label, bubble text)
observedStyles.component: chat-header, sheet, buttons, row, bubble, text-field value, search query, context menu item
sheet body, list row preview, security warning title(600), mono block, file name(500), status bar time(600)
row value, text field label/error, tip bar, segmented, sender name(600), approval scope
large-title subtitle, date chip(500), unread divider(600), tags(600), badge count (list row)
tab label(500), bubble time (latin), tab badge(600), chart ticks (rf-size-caption)

observedValuesPx.note: Only rf-gap exists as a variable (16, never referenced by mobile masters). Everything else is a literal; dominant rhythm is 4/8/12/16 with horizontal screen gutter 16 (content width 361 = 393 - 2*16).

literalsUsed.15: list-row avatar cornerRadius override for agent/channel avatars (52 px avatar, glyph 28)
literalsUsed.[12,12,0,0]: sheet top corners (=rf-radius-sheet written as literal)

radii.note: Avatar-agent corner radius is proportional to size (8 at 28, 10 at 36, 11 at 40/44, 18 at 72) via per-instance overrides instead of a token.

usage.0.5: tab bar top, composer top, chat header bottom, list row summary bottom, row bottom (rf-line)
usage.1: text field box, buttons secondary, context menu/sheet/reaction bar borders, qr, origin, approval card, charts card
usage.1.5: checkbox/radio off outline, radio on ring, composer draft checkbox, bubble error state outline (B05 override)
usage.2: avatar ring override (C09, 40px), chart series lines

strokeWidthsPx.note: No stroke-width variables; strokeAlignment default (inner/center per Pencil default).

elevation.note: Only three shadow styles exist, all outer, color $rf-shadow (light #0000001F, dark #0000007A).
elevation.noShadow: cards, banners, bubbles, buttons, tab bar and headers have no shadow (hairline strokes instead)

touchTargets.note: Information from component sizes: 44 is used for info button, header actions, back, composer attach/close, menu items (44 high), tab item (44 high), reaction cell (40x44), chat row (72). Below 44 and without a larger hit frame in the design: switch 51x31, checkbox 24, radio 24, send button 32, icon tile 30, search clear 17, avatar 28, M/Chart view toggle 32, segmented 36 high, tip bar 38 high, text-button 44 ok, button text 44, approval buttons 44.
